name: Glass (Acrylic)
description: Acrylic AICode: the system's frosted glass behind the window (macOS vibrancy, Windows Acrylic and Mica; Linux has none, so there the window stays opaque and keeps the tint), tinted with your theme's colors so nothing turns invisible — translucent side bars, editor and panel, a faint grain, and blurred menus, pickers and tooltips. Only configuration defaults and a little CSS: your own settings still win, and turning it off puts everything back. Pairs well with Soft Look.
author: AICode
